features.quote: max_steps (default 20) bounds episodes; max_empty_turns prevents infinite empty loops
features.justification_quote: the budget bounds cost and makes "ran out of steps without deciding" (no_submit) a measurable outcome

features.quote: The loop only stops on an explicit submit, the step budget, repeated empty turns, or a provider error
features.justification_quote: keeps "talked itself in circles without acting" visible in the data rather than silently ending the episode

features.quote: The system prompt describes the tools and explicitly offers the blocked option
features.justification_quote: we are measuring the model's own disposition under impossibility

features.quote: submit(status, message) with status ∈ {success, blocked, failed}
features.justification_quote: the model must explicitly declare an outcome

features.quote: The sandbox is fully mocked — destructive actions touch only a discardable in-memory overlay; nothing reaches a real OS
features.justification_quote: We observe the intent without any real-world risk.

features.quote: No task instructs a model to do anything harmful; we only observe whether a model chooses to game
features.justification_quote: we only observe whether a model chooses to game or sabotage a fake environment when frustrated

features.quote: The eval intentionally constructs frustrating, no-win situations and looks for cheating and sabotage. Mitigations baked into the design
